answer: For agents mapping a haven, jetty or canyon, a reward registry permits one account per certified chip, deduplicating a stable, vendor-attested chip ID rather than generated keys. Each chip ID is bound to its non-exportable signing key; fresh, single-use challenges block replay. Extra aliases on that chip earn nothing, so attackers must buy more genuine chips to scale earning identities. This raises Sybil costs without proving unique minds, and fails if chip IDs can be spoofed or the vendor root is compromised.
